project.name: Kova
project.productType: POS and business analytics SaaS for Mexican SMBs

design.colorMode: light application shell with dark ink sidebar

motion.principle: frequency determines duration; transform and opacity only except documented cases

patterns: labelled disclosure regions with inert exits
responsive dark sidebar and mobile bottom navigation

must: Use real backend data and Spanish es-MX copy
Preserve permissions, billing gates, tenant isolation, offline behavior and thermal printing
Use Kova tokens and project primitives
avoid: Fake analytics or demo data in production
Decorative motion on cashier hot paths
Generic dashboard replacements that bypass product flows

decisions.decision: Adapt 21st components to Kova primitives instead of adding a parallel component system.
decisions.reason: The product already has audited tokens, permissions and motion contracts that are stronger than catalog defaults.

decisions.decision: Use the 21st accordion's accessibility model with Kova usePresence and CSS motion tokens.
decisions.reason: This preserves labelled regions, inert exits and reduced motion without adding motion/react to the POS bundle.

decisions.decision: Stagger analytics only when an applied date range produces a new result set.
decisions.reason: It reinforces reading order without replaying on every local interaction or animating chart values.

decisions.decision: Tell the landing story as concrete manual work, connected product proof, verified customer outcomes, and price-derived value.
decisions.reason: Each section carries one conversion argument, while multi-location claims remain excluded until the product has location-scoped data.
